stage6_units.title: Live Cross-Terminal Coordination — Atomic CAS Claim Broker Extending Existing System
stage6_units.rationale: Loop 4 scrutiny (58/100, FAIL) + integration audit (CREATES_FRAGMENTATION) reveal: PRISM ALREADY has a live coordination daemon at H:/prism/.claude/helpers/agent-coordination-daemon.mjs writing to H:/prism/state/shared/ACTIVE_WORK_REGISTRY.json, AGENT_WORKBOARD.json, FILE_LOCKS.json, AGENT_COORDINATION_STATUS.json (pid=35480, 130 agents, 114 chat entries). Both Claude and Codex families auto-detect identity and post to AGENT_CHAT.jsonl every few minutes. Creating parallel ACTIVE_CLAIMS.json would fragment truth. THIS UNIT must EXTEND the existing system (not replace it) with: (a) atomic compare-and-swap claim acquisition using proper-lockfile npm package (solves Windows fs.writeFileSync non-atomicity), (b) single-call CAS API that fuses duplication-check + claim-acquire (eliminates TOCTOU race), (c) daemon-less fallback — terminals self-renew leases via exponential backoff if daemon crashes, (d) zombie reaper for agents stuck in 'compacting' state >600s (current bug: 130 zombies), (e) deadlock detection via claim-graph cycle check, (f) monotonic claim sequence number for tie-breaking, (g) clock-drift tolerance via relative-TTL rather than absolute expiresAt.
stage6_units.fourLoop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

concurrencyPrimitives.atomicWrite: proper-lockfile npm package (cross-platform file lock, tested on Windows NTFS H: drive)
concurrencyPrimitives.casApi: tryAcquireClaim(dupCheck, claimTarget, agentId): {acquired:boolean, conflictsWith?:agentId} — single call fuses duplication-check + claim-acquire
concurrencyPrimitives.heartbeatMechanism: relative TTL (renewed every 30s, expires 120s after last renew), not absolute expiresAt — clock-drift safe
concurrencyPrimitives.zombieReaper: runs every 60s in daemon, reaps claims with heartbeat age >600s and status='compacting' (addresses current 130-zombie bug)
concurrencyPrimitives.deadlockDetection: claim-graph cycle check on every acquire attempt — throws DeadlockError if A→B→A cycle detected
concurrencyPrimitives.daemonFallback: if daemon-heartbeat absent for >180s, terminals self-renew leases with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s cap)
concurrencyPrimitives.sequenceNumber: monotonic ULID per claim for tie-breaking in race-reconciliation

exitGate.criteria: Single-system truth: extends ACTIVE_WORK_REGISTRY.json + FILE_LOCKS.json + AGENT_WORKBOARD.json (no parallel files). proper-lockfile CAS primitive verified on Windows NTFS. tryAcquireClaim() is single atomic call. Relative-TTL heartbeat. Zombie reaper clears current 130 'compacting' zombies within first run. Deadlock detection via claim-graph cycle check. Daemon-less fallback via self-renew exponential backoff. Integration test: 5 concurrent terminals, exactly 1 claim succeeds, 4 blocked with clear conflictsWith. Stress test: 50 concurrent claim attempts across 5 terminals, zero race conditions, zero double-claims. Existing AGENT_CHAT.md flow unchanged (Claude + Codex families still post). DuplicationGuardEngine.mustCheckBeforeCreating now calls tryAcquireClaim() atomically. Backwards compat: existing coordination-daemon.mjs survives, ACTIVE_WORK_REGISTRY.json still readable by existing consumers. getActiveWork() API reads existing files — zero schema migration for readers.
